subject: CMake fixes + README update (#1276)
reason: The change modifies only CMake build scripts (CMakeLists.txt, cmake/Modules/*, deps/*/CMakeLists.txt) and the README. It alters how the binaries are compiled and linked (sanitizer flag plumbing, tcmalloc linkage via pkg-config, jemalloc build error handling, Lua mkstemp detection) and documentation, but no Valkey runtime source code: no command, reply, replication, persistence, or cluster behavior changes between the parent and the change. Any build problems would surface when the runner compiles the builds, not in a runtime scenario, so there is nothing for the fuzzer's experiments or oracles
